title: Chay Prometisqa Devotokuna
intro: Huk yupaychasqa profetan runakuna ukhupi purirqan, cheqaq kaqman waqyaspa. Askhan k’ullu kaspanku kutirirqanku, ichaqa huk huch’uy dedicado muyullan chay waqyakuyta kutichirqanku, hinaspan tukuy sonqowan prometekurqanku. Iskayrayaywanmi pruebasqa karqanku, hanaq pachapi mikhunata maskhayta atrevikurqanku. Mana kuyurispa Dios sonqo kasqankuqa iñiyninkupi mana tiempoyoq yachachikuymanmi tukupurqan. ¿Pikunataq karanku?
clues: Huk huch’uy t’aqapin karqayku, paykunan hatarirqayku huk divina misionta yanapanaykupaq, askha runakunaq mana iñisqanku tiempopi.
Huk yupaychasqa profeta hamuspa waqyawarqanku Allahpa ñanninpi aliado hina sayanaykupaq.
Profeta tapuqtinmi pikunachus Divinoq yanapaqnin kanqa nispa, mana iskayrayaspa kutichirqayku.
Mana manchakuspan mañakurqayku hanaq pachamanta uraykamusqa milagro fiestata, sonqoykuta kallpachananpaq.
Profetanchismi yuyarichiwaranchis Allahta yupaychananchispaq cheqaq iñiq kaspaqa, chaywanpas huch’uyyaykukuspa mañakusqanchismi yupaychasqa karqan.
Ñuqaykuqa karqaniku dedicasqa ukhu muyu, mana kuyurispa iñiyta prometekuqmi, Maryampa churin Isawan kuska.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
